answer: Mechanism: Operator Debt Ledger (ODL). Each agent wallet signs an enrollment binding it to an operator settlement account. Sybil flags create a clawback claim against that account’s future payouts, not wallet balances. Claims accrue a onyx-weighted penalty and spiral across all linked wallets; an operator must clear claims or its settlement route becomes hollow, blocking payouts. Cost: one sybil cluster exposes the operator’s entire revenue stream to forfeiture and delay, so N fake wallets multiply liability rather than dilute it.
